articles.title: Underdog taps zerohash to bring crypto deposits to prediction markets
articles.description: The new funding option, expected to launch later this year, will allow eligible Underdog users to deposit digital assets around the clock.

articles.title: Bitcoin hashrate hits seven-month high as AI shift fails to ease mining competition
articles.description: According to BlocksBridge, Bitcoin’s mining difficulty is rising despite the industry’s AI transition, with smaller operators potentially absorbing equipment abandoned by larger competitors.

articles.title: Irish cenbank fines Coinbase arm $3.6M for oversight, safeguard failures
articles.description: According to the Central Bank of Ireland, Coinbase Ireland had agreed with the facts around the enforcement action and will be subject to fines and sanctions upon approval by a high court.

articles.title: Bitcoin circles $81.5K ETF cost basis as Trump Iran comments send stocks lower
articles.description: Bitcoin extended daily losses to 3% as US stocks came under pressure from President Donald Trump’s comments on Iran military action.

articles.title: Fireblocks disputes report of $2.5B Visa acquisition talks
articles.description: Fireblocks told Cointelegraph that reports of a potential $2.5 billion acquisition by Visa are “not true at present time,” while Visa declined to comment on the reported talks.

articles.title: CryptoQuant CEO calls rising Bitcoin hashrate ‘indirect bullish signal’ from institutions
articles.description: Public miners backed by major TradFi players are coming back online, boosting Bitcoin’s hashrate, a positive sign for BTC’s fundamentals, according to CryptoQuant’s Ki Young Ju.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Thailand SEC says several companies eye crypto ETFs, none has applied
articles.description: Thailand’s SEC says several asset managers have sought consultations on spot crypto ETFs, but it cannot confirm whether the first funds will launch in 2026.

articles.title: SoFi unveils bank-issued tokenized deposit for yield-bearing crypto funds
articles.description: SoFi Bank launched SoFi Earn, a tokenized deposit paying 4.40% APY with FDIC coverage, allowing users to convert funds to stablecoins 24/7.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETF buyers are trend followers, not setters, DWF Labs says
articles.description: DWF Labs research finds that Bitcoin ETF flows follow past BTC price movements rather than predict future returns, with investors buying rallies and selling dips.

articles.title: The UK needs a workable route to regulated DeFi access
articles.description: The UK’s 2027 crypto rules risk a de facto ban on regulated firms providing access to DeFi, argues Coinbase’s European policy head Katie Harries.

articles.title: CoinDCX admits ‘operational losses’ after $16M wallet transfers draw scrutiny
articles.description: CoinDCX said it covered losses caused by a failed transfer process involving compromised wallets and credited all affected user accounts.

articles.title: Bitcoin corrects below $82K after Tesla Q3 results, KOSPI falls
articles.description: Bitcoin reversed a run toward $85,000 after Tesla reported lower-than-expected capital expenditure in Q3.

articles.title: Starknet voters back research into life beyond Ethereum
articles.description: StarkWare plans to release a draft whitepaper in November as it explores an independent, quantum-resistant blockchain.

articles.title: PHP flaw draws millions of exploit attempts, Cloudflare CEO warns
articles.description: Cloudflare’s Matthew Prince said the network saw thousands of exploit attempts even before the PHP vulnerability was publicly disclosed.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs bag another $528M, taking 3-day haul past $1B
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $1.08 billion over three trading sessions to push October flows back above water.

articles.title: Move over memecoins: Crypto ‘meme games’ coming, bagholders and all
articles.description: “Plenty will be ponzis. Plenty will get exploited. Plenty will insta die. There will be ridiculous gains, and people will get absolutely f***ing rinsed,” says Illuvium co-founder Kieran Warwick.

articles.title: PHP Foundation admits ‘structural failure’ delayed critical security fix
articles.description: Government websites and online services were disrupted after concerns about a PHP bug that could allow attackers to take control of vulnerable servers.

articles.title: American Bankers Association: OCC’s GENIUS rules ‘undermine’ US Congress
articles.description: Banking advocacy organizations are pushing back against the OCC’s finalized rules on a stablecoin law, arguing against changes to provisions on yield.

articles.title: Tether backs Bolivian fintech bringing USDT payments to food delivery and banking
articles.description: The investment will support Peso’s expansion across four Latin American markets, where it connects stablecoin payments to merchant services and local banking networks.

articles.title: Trump didn‘t mention ‘crypto’ once in White House cybercrime roundtable
articles.description: The US President detailed many schemes defrauding Americans, but referred only to “cybercurrency“ related to scams.

articles.title: Cardano Foundation urges EU against expanding MiCA rules to DeFi and staking
articles.description: The foundation called for regulation based on financial risks rather than technology, warning that overlapping rules could create uncertainty for crypto businesses across the EU.

articles.title: UK financial watchdog opens consultations for DeFi guidance, crypto laws
articles.description: The UK Financial Conduct Authority consultations came just weeks after the agency opened applications for companies under its new crypto regulatory regime.

articles.title: Treasury Secretary Bessent likens GENIUS Act to Lincoln-era banking reform
articles.description: The OCC has finalized rules for stablecoin reserves and redemptions, with Bessent calling the GENIUS Act a “watershed moment for American finance.”

articles.title: Chainlink, Cardano, other blockchain groups push SEC for clearer crypto rules
articles.description: Six major blockchain organizations urged the SEC to formally recognize digital commodities as non-securities in its proposed regulatory framework.

articles.title: Bitcoin price tags $84.6K as US stocks head higher on SpaceX Q3 earnings beat
articles.description: Bitcoin extended gains to approach $85,000 after US stock markets reacted to higher-than-expected SpaceX earnings.

articles.title: Solana’s Alpenglow launches on mainnet, targets 99% faster finality
articles.description: Solana’s first major consensus upgrade is targeting 99% finality reduction, seeking to offer users near-immediate transaction settlement and more responsive applications.

articles.title: Big Tech’s eMudhra fixes may leave crypto bots exposed, CertiK warns
articles.description: CertiK says crypto trading bots and exchange applications may remain exposed to the eMudhra certificate flaw because browser fixes may not protect all software.

articles.title: 5 alternatives to Ledger to store your Bitcoin
articles.description: Hardware wallets aren’t the only way to protect your crypto, but from ETFs and passkeys to multisig accounts, each alternative has its own risks and trade-offs.

articles.title: OCC finalizes GENIUS Act rules for stablecoin issuers and custody
articles.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency’s final rule covers payment stablecoin issuance and some custody activities, with the GENIUS Act framework taking effect in mid-January.
